summary: ioneer Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting, including poll results for director re-elections, remuneration report, and equity issuances. All resolutions were carried. The filing is a routine disclosure of a foreign private issuer's annual meeting outcome; no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or activist campaign is present. As a standard reporting obligation, this filing does not meet any special-situations category.
